facts.en: Completed an outdoor programme administration diploma at Fictional Mossbank College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构苔岸学院完成户外项目行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid operations assistant at Fictional Acorn Trails from 2021-05 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-05 至 2026-08 在虚构橡果步道机构任有薪运营助理。

facts.en: Prepared participant lists, equipment counts and transport times for day workshops.
facts.zh: 为日间工作坊准备参与者名单、器材数量及交通时间。

facts.en: Checked returned equipment against issue sheets and reported missing items to the operations lead.
facts.zh: 按领用单核对归还器材，并向运营负责人报告遗失物品。

facts.en: Sent weather-related schedule changes using wording approved by the programme lead.
facts.zh: 使用项目负责人批准的措辞发送天气相关排期变更。

facts.en: Qualified instructors led outdoor sessions and made route-safety decisions; the candidate handled logistics.
facts.zh: 合格教练带领户外活动并作出路线安全决定；候选人负责后勤。

facts.en: Received the fictional Trail Response Awareness certificate from Fictional Path School on 2022-05-12.
facts.zh: 2022-05-12 获得虚构步道学校颁发的虚构“步道应急意识”证书。

facts.en: The certificate’s printed validity ended on 2025-05-12.
facts.zh: 该证书印明的有效期于 2025-05-12 结束。

facts.en: As of 2026-09, no renewal, refresher assessment or replacement certificate is recorded.
facts.zh: 截至 2026-09，未记录续证、复训考核或替代证书。

facts.en: Attended an employer equipment-storage briefing in 2026-02; it was not a certificate renewal.
facts.zh: 2026-02 参加雇主器材存储说明会；该说明会不是证书续期。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet validation lists and shared booking calendars.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格数据验证列表及共享预订日历。

facts.en: Revised the equipment-return checklist with an instructor in 2025-10.
facts.zh: 2025-10 与一名教练共同修订器材归还核对表。

facts.en: Personally added item codes and damaged-item fields; the instructor supplied inspection criteria.
facts.zh: 个人添加物品代码及损坏物品字段；检查标准由教练提供。

facts.en: A 2025-11 review found complete return sheets for 18 of 20 sampled workshops.
facts.zh: 2025-11 的审核发现，20 场抽样工作坊中有 18 场具备完整的归还单。

facts.en: No comparable pre-checklist sample was retained.
facts.zh: 未留存使用该核对表前的可比样本。

facts.en: Logged participant accessibility requests and referred suitability decisions to the programme lead.
facts.zh: 记录参与者无障碍需求，并将适宜性决定转交项目负责人。

facts.en: Prepared a proposed colour-coded store layout in 2026-04; implementation was deferred.
facts.zh: 2026-04 拟定颜色编码库房布局方案；实施被推迟。

facts.en: Volunteered at a fictional seed-exchange table for 2 afternoons in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构种子交换摊位做了 2 个下午的志愿服务。

facts.en: Created a personal plant sketch index in 2023 without surveying or identifying plants professionally.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人植物素描索引，未从事专业植物调查或鉴定。

facts.en: Enjoys carving vegetable-print stamps.
facts.zh: 爱好雕刻蔬菜印章。

facts.en: No instructor licence or independently led outdoor instruction is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录教练执照或独立带领户外教学的经历。
